questions.question: How many pull requests touched at least one file under `src/auth/`?

calls.name: describe
query

input.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.number) AS pr_count
FROM pull_requests pr
JOIN files f ON pr.ref = f.ref
WHERE f.path LIKE 'src/auth/%';

calls.name: query

input.sql:
SELECT f.ref, f.path
FROM files f
WHERE f.path LIKE '%auth%'
ORDER BY f.ref
LIMIT 200;

calls.name: query
query

input.sql:
SELECT pr.number, pr.files
FROM pull_requests pr
WHERE pr.files LIKE '%src/auth/%'
ORDER BY pr.number
LIMIT 500;

questions.question: Which pull requests authored by haddad had at least one failing CI run? Answer with their refs.

calls.name: describe
query

input.sql:
SELECT p.ref AS pr_ref, p.number AS pr_number, SUM(CASE WHEN lower(cr.status) LIKE '%fail%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failing_runs
FROM pull_requests p
LEFT JOIN ci_runs cr ON cr.pr = p.number
WHERE p.author = 'haddad'
GROUP BY p.ref, p.number
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN lower(cr.status) LIKE '%fail%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
ORDER BY p.number;

SELECT f.path, f.service, SUM(pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS churn
FROM files f
JOIN pull_requests pr ON pr.files LIKE '%' || '"' || f.path || '"' || '%'
GROUP BY f.path, f.service
ORDER BY churn DESC
LIMIT 5

JOIN pull_requests p ON p.files LIKE '%"' || f.path || '"%'

GROUP BY s.ref, f.ref, f.path
ORDER BY total_churn DESC
LIMIT 10;

questions.question: Which team owns the service whose files have the most total churn (additions plus deletions summed over every pull request that touched a file in that service)? Answer with the team name.

calls.name: describe
query

input.sql: SELECT number, files FROM pull_requests LIMIT 10

calls.name: query

input.sql:
WITH pr_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT pr.number AS pr_number, f.service AS service, (pr.additions + pr.deletions) AS churn
  FROM pull_requests pr
  JOIN files f ON pr.files LIKE '%' || f.path || '%'
)
SELECT s.owner, ps.service, SUM(ps.churn) AS total_churn
FROM pr_services ps
JOIN services s ON s.name = ps.service
GROUP BY s.owner, ps.service
ORDER BY total_churn DESC
LIMIT 10;

calls.name: query

input.sql:
WITH pr_file AS (
  SELECT f.service AS service_name, p.ref AS pr_ref, p.number, p.additions, p.deletions
  FROM pull_requests p
  JOIN files f
    ON p.files LIKE '%"' || f.path || '"%'
), pr_service AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT service_name, pr_ref, number, additions, deletions
  FROM pr_file
), churn_per_service AS (
  SELECT service_name, SUM(additions + deletions) AS total_churn
  FROM pr_service
  GROUP BY service_name
)
SELECT cs.service_name, cs.total_churn, s.owner
FROM churn_per_service cs
LEFT JOIN services s ON s.name = cs.service_name
ORDER BY cs.total_churn DESC
LIMIT 10;
